statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-62909 (GHSA-9mr8-pwpw-3j2w) is a .NET elevation of privilege issue in the runtime's diagnostics IPC: a missing error check applies an improper access control list to a shared resource, which lets a local user elevate privileges. Microsoft lists Linux and macOS as the affected platforms and the .NET 10.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 10.0.0 through 10.0.10 and fixed in 10.0.11 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9mr8-pwpw-3j2w, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/429, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.11/10.0.11.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every build ships the .NET runtime, which implements diagnostics IPC, at its own .NET version: the Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework in dotnet10-runtime and in the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, and the .NET runtime packs in dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap: 10.0.2 to 10.0.10 in the first nine builds and 10.0.13 or later from 10.0.13-r0 on. The range ends at 10.0.13-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-62909 (GHSA-9mr8-pwpw-3j2w) is a .NET elevation of privilege issue in the runtime's diagnostics IPC: a missing error check applies an improper access control list to a shared resource, allowing local elevation of privilege. Microsoft lists Linux and macOS as the affected platforms and the .NET 8.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 8.0.0 through 8.0.29 and fixed in 8.0.30 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9mr8-pwpw-3j2w, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/429, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.30/8.0.30.md). DHI dotnet8-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 8 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 220 packages of the ten published builds (8.0.23-r0, 8.0.24-r0, 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.26-r0, 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.29-r0, 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.32-r0, 8.0.33-r0 and 8.0.34-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every build ships the native .NET runtime (libcoreclr.so), which hosts the diagnostics IPC endpoint, at its own .NET version, in the Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework of dotnet8-runtime and of the .NET SDK held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap, and in that version's runtime pack and Crossgen2 pack held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap; the NativeAOT compiler pack held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap, whose static runtime libraries include the event pipe, is at the same version. That version is 8.0.23 to 8.0.29 in the first six builds and 8.0.31 or later from 8.0.31-r0 on. No 8.0.30 build was published; the build after 8.0.29-r0 is 8.0.31-r0. The range ends at 8.0.31-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
